neighbours.label: marking change between past and present (has changed, then and now, different today than)
fire: Our little village has changed a lot since the railway arrived.
The book shows photos of the harbour then and now side by side.
Farming is a very different job today than it was a century ago.
The way people shop has changed dramatically in ten years.
My old school has changed so much that I barely recognised it.
Compare the city skyline then with the towers you see now.
Medicine has changed and improved enormously over time.
Life on the island is far different now than in my childhood.
quiet: Our little village has a bakery right next to the railway station.
The book shows photos of the harbour at sunrise and at sunset.
Farming is a very demanding job for families in the valley.
The way people shop in this town is mostly by car.
My old school has a big garden where I used to play.
Compare the city skyline at night with the view from the hill.
Medicine is expensive and hard to find in rural areas.
Life on the island is quiet and simple for most families.
